description: This file defines the PaymentMethodInterface interface for payment methods in the Goteo project, specifying required methods for implementing payment gateways.

classes.name: PaymentMethodInterface
classes.description: Interface that all payment methods in Goteo must implement, defining methods for payment processing, refunds, and related functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the payment method with a User object.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Deprecated static method to get the payment method ID (max 20 chars).

methods.name: getIdNonStatic
methods.description: Returns the ID of the payment method as a non-static method.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the payment method.

methods.name: getDesc
methods.description: Returns a short description of the payment method.

methods.name: getIcon
methods.description: Returns an icon representing the payment method.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Determines if the payment method should be active, possibly depending on the amount.

methods.name: isPublic
methods.description: Determines if the payment method is public or private.

methods.name: setInvest
methods.description: Sets the Invest object for the payment method.

methods.name: getInvest
methods.description: Retrieves the Invest object associated with the payment method.

methods.name: setRequest
methods.description: Sets the Symfony Request object for the payment process.

methods.name: getDefaultHttpResponse
methods.description: Provides a redirect response after purchase completion, if applicable.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Retrieves the current Symfony Request object.

methods.name: purchase
methods.description: Initiates the payment process when the user clicks 'pay'.

methods.name: completePurchase
methods.description: Completes the purchase after returning from the payment gateway or receiving notification.

methods.name: refundable
methods.description: Indicates if the payment method supports refunds.

methods.name: refund
methods.description: Processes a refund through the payment gateway.

methods.name: calculateCommission
methods.description: Calculates bank fees based on configuration and rules.

methods.name: isInternal
methods.description: Indicates if the payment is internal and does not increase raised amounts.

methods.name: isSubscription
methods.description: Indicates if the payment method supports recurring payments.
